text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Grass 
Wonder, we decided to stop by the shopping 
district.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"We've arrived. This shop right here is my 
go-to florist~."
choice_data_list: What are you going to buy?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Just some flowers. The vase in the dorm 
lobby was completely empty and looking 
rather lonely...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since we have a vase here, I figured I'd 
arrange some flowers in it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Having pretty flowers along your daily 
route makes you happy just by looking at 
them, right?
choice_data_list: I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since I was little, my passion grew, and I 
dedicated myself to ikebana with great 
enthusiasm—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to stay connected with flowers 
in this way makes me so very happy~."
choice_data_list: I'd love to see your work sometime.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely. I'd love for you to learn 
more about my hobby as well, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. I'll give you a hand, so would 
you like to arrange some flowers with me?
choice_data_list: I wonder if I can do it right?

Once it's finished, let's display it in 
the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Flower arrangement is 
ultimately just one path of discipline.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Seeking the path means— firmly treading 
the way you have chosen, with upright 
purpose."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The beauty of it is that if you steadily 
walk a straight path, you'll eventually 
reach completion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. See? In essence, it's no different 
from a race, is it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So you'll be just fine, Trainer. Let's do 
our best together~♪

Afterward, I picked out flower materials 
together with Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I agree. Having flowers in your 
daily life is simply wonderful, isn't 
it~?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Spring flowers in spring, summer flowers 
in summer— it allows you to truly feel the 
changing of the seasons.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"This is a room where I spend a lot of 
time. I must think very carefully about 
what kind of flowers would be best—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, and we also have to pick out a vase. 
Fufufu, there are so many things to think 
about~♪"

Afterward, I picked out floral materials 
together with a cheerful Grass Wonder.
